articles.title: Supreme Court Says Private Groups Can't Sue to Protect Voters in 7 States
articles.summary: Imagine needing help to vote because you can't read the ballot. The Supreme Court just let a ruling stand that stops private groups from suing to protect that right in 7 states. This could make it harder for some people to vote.

articles.title: Alan Greenspan, the Man Who Ran America's Money for 19 Years, Dies at 100
articles.summary: He was like a rock star of money. Alan Greenspan led the Federal Reserve for almost 20 years, helping the U.S. economy boom. He died Monday at age 100. But his legacy is complicated—some blame him for the 2008 financial crisis.

articles.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer Quits After a Really Rough Year
articles.summary: Imagine being the boss of a country and so many people in your own team want you gone that you have to quit. That's what happened to UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer. He resigned Monday after bad election results and fights with his own party.
